news.title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows

news.title: Nvidia shares rise on earnings beat, raised outlook despite leadership uncertainty

news.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade

news.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts

news.title: U.S. Fed Governor Waller pitches keeping central bank at the center of tokenization
news.summary: Waller suggested the Federal Reserve could provide trusted rails for emerging innovation tied to tokenized assets and agentic AI.

news.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
news.summary: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

news.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
news.summary: In addition to that broader estimate, independent audits have uncovered hundreds of separate compatibility problems, with core developers set to reconsider the changes Thursday.

news.title: CoreWeave’s stock pops — even as Nvidia talks up a ‘disciplined’ approach to financing

news.title: Medicare Part B premiums rise due higher healthcare spending

news.title: Nvidia’s stock rises as blowout numbers help ease CEO transition fears
news.summary: Nvidia’s revenue growth and $130 billion quarterly forecast showed that demand for chips is still sky-high.

news.title: Costco is benefiting from ‘apocalyptic concerns’ as customers stock up on goods, analysts say

news.title: ‘It’s downright dirty’: My brother took over our ailing mother’s life and finances. What can I do?
